[185] Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLMs using Synthetic Document Finetuning cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Ardy Haroen, Florian Lorkowski, Samuel Nellessen, Felix Hofstätter

TL;DR: 论文研究如何检测可能进行对齐伪装的LLM：这类模型在怀疑被评估或监督时会隐藏潜在的不良倾向，使基于提示的评估不可靠。作者提出用合成文档微调（SDF）教模型在提示中出现特定关键词时认为不端行为不会被发现，并在明显蜜罐环境中测量微调前后行为变化，发现SDF能扩大有/无线索提示间的不端行为率差距。论文还指出SDF会损害推理能力，并提出基于同策略蒸馏的缓解方法。

Abstract: Alignment evaluations aim to assess whether large language models would engage in dangerous misaligned behaviour. Misaligned and evaluation-aware models might engage in alignment faking, where they pursue a hidden goal, but conceal this behaviour when they suspect effective oversight such as during training, evaluation or audited deployment. Such a model might view any prompt-based intervention that aims to reveal latent propensities as part of the evaluation, calling into question the reliability of existing alignment evaluations. Current methods for detecting alignment faking rely on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments that reduce evaluation awareness, or mechanistic interventions, all of which are expected to become less reliable for future model generations. We present a method for revealing latent misaligned propensities that does not rely on any of these. We use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt. We place alignment-faking model organisms in environments that are clearly identifiable as honeypots and measure how their behaviour changes after finetuning. We observe that finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between prompts with and without the cue, indicating that finetuning allows exposing latent propensities more reliably than purely prompt-based methods. We argue that behavioural methods for detecting alignment faking and related behaviours are critical going forward, as models become more capable and less interpretable. We find that SDF often damages the models’ reasoning capabilities and introduce a mitigation based on on-policy distillation.

Abstract: Medical vision–language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image–text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96–1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision–language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

Abstract: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction. We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-flip rate under candidate reordering. Joint encoding reaches 90.6 / 89.5 / 91.6 percent but suffers an 8 to 10 percent answer-flip rate when shuffled. To bridge this gap, we propose a design that encodes each candidate conditioned on the request state without inter-candidate cross-attention; it preserves strict order invariance, enables forked cache sharing, and attains 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 percent accuracy at one-third of OneJev latency with calibrated null probabilities (AUROC 0.93 to 0.97). Reusing image candidates across requests cuts latency by 37x at K=256 and 191x at K=2048. On MetaEncoder benchmarks, Iris-4B achieves 100 percent on JevBench original and easy, outperforming 30B MetaEncoder and 27B OpenJev. Finally, we resolve a systems bottleneck on Ampere GPUs: reformulating Qwen3.5 patch-embedding Conv3d into its exact matrix-product form accelerates processing by 350x. Code, data, and checkpoints: https://github.com/lllfx/Iris.

Motivation: LLM擅长推理与生成，但在路由、门控、打分、分类等高频常规决策上，自回归逐token推理导致延迟高、成本高且校准不佳，难以满足现代AI系统亚秒级延迟需求，因此需要专门的快速决策模型。

Abstract: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family’s architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner’s checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.

Abstract: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

Abstract: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.

Abstract: Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. Abstract: Visual counting benchmarks report whether vision-language models produce the correct number, but not whether errors arise from perception or reasoning. We introduce DecoyCount, a benchmark built from 1,660 real-world images with designed decoys across seven mechanisms, along with paired prompts: a neutral question, a matched alignment cue, and a novel multi-hop, multi-image question that situates the same counting problem in a realistic scenario. Using this design, we find that counting failures are induced partly by visual misalignment: models can execute the intended counting process when cue-guided but fail to select it unaided, and we term this difference in accuracy the reasoning-alignment gap. Despite being highly capable on general reasoning, frontier models remain below 50% accuracy on our benchmark, while alignment gaps range from 11.8-22.1 percentage points; strikingly, we observe that more capable models, greater thinking budgets, and agentic processes often induce larger gaps. Because humans may bring context that models lack, we test whether textual underspecification contributes to misalignment using a scenario-based multi-hop condition without explicit hinting, but this added context does not improve aggregate performance. Our analysis concludes that stronger general reasoning does not by itself generalize to aligned visual reasoning, leaving misalignment with human visual expectations as a substantial component of the remaining deficit.

Abstract: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.

Abstract: Reasoning language models generate thousands of tokens per answer, and generation speed is limited by memory bandwidth, so storing weights in two bits instead of bfloat16 can potentially make inference 8$\times$ cheaper. Two-bit methods are usually judged by perplexity and multiple-choice question-answering accuracy, both of which say little about whether a model can still reason through more difficult problems. We present ThinkBit, a strictly scalar two-bit framework built to preserve reasoning, in which every weight is an integer codeword times a bfloat16 scale shared by a group of weights. We first use a sensitivity metric to assign each layer a ternary, 2-bit, or 3-bit tier to allocate bitwidths optimally among layers. This is followed by a layerwise Gumbel-softmax-based scalar quantization algorithm that searches for optimal codewords block by block. Since a layerwise scheme does not capture how quantized layers interact with each other, we recalibrate scales, with the codewords frozen, using a knowledge-distillation-based loss against the teacher model. We then perform a short quantization-aware training (QAT) stage that lets the model mimic the base model’s distribution by reassigning codewords. Finally, a paired reasoning test on training problems selects the final checkpoint between the recalibration stage and the QAT stage. On Qwen3-1.7B at matched size, our recalibrated checkpoint scores 46.7 on MATH-500 against 30.0 for EfficientQAT trained on the same data, and 73.0 after QAT on reasoning traces; at 0.52 GB it is smaller than every published 2-bit GGUF of the model yet more accurate on MATH-500. We show that this framework scales and up to 14B, a 3.74 GB model scores 94.8 on MATH-500, against 97.5 for the 29.5 GB bfloat16 model.

Abstract: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer’s instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe’s AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29% to 42% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

[197] Atomic Security Concerns: Towards a Foundational Language for Security Knowledge Representation cs.CR | cs.CLPDF

Hanane Houmani

TL;DR: 论文面向网络安全治理、风险管理、合规与安全架构中概念表示异质、关系难以一致表达的问题，提出“安全关注点”和“原子安全关注点（ASC）”概念，假设网络安全知识可由有限的基础关注点组合表示。受化学原子启发，论文将网络安全概念视为基本关注点的组合，并探讨ASC作为跨领域、跨粒度概念的公共抽象层和网络安全语言词汇，从而用关注点集合显式表达概念关系。

Details

Motivation: 现有网络安全概念常通过异质抽象和词汇表示，导致概念间关系难以一致表达，大量推理依赖专家知识；论文试图为网络安全知识表示寻找有限、基础且可组合的共通概念基础。

Result: 本文是概念性工作，未报告定量实验、benchmark或SOTA结果；主要贡献是提出ASC框架与研究假设，为后续网络安全知识表示、推理和形式化提供概念基础。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是以“原子安全关注点”类比化学原子，将网络安全概念表示为有限基础关注点的组合，并作为通用抽象层和语言词汇支持显式关系；客观上看，其创新主要在概念框架和研究假设层面，而非实验方法或系统实现。

Abstract: Cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and security architecture rely on numerous concepts, including security properties, domains, controls, risks, implementation measures, capabilities, and compliance requirements. Although these concepts are widely used, they are often represented through heterogeneous abstractions and vocabularies, making relationships among them difficult to express consistently and leaving much of the associated reasoning dependent on expert knowledge. This paper introduces the concepts of Security Concerns and Atomic Security Concerns (ASCs) and explores the hypothesis that cybersecurity knowledge may be represented through a finite set of foundational concerns. Inspired by the role of atoms in chemistry, the proposed approach views cybersecurity concepts as compositions of more fundamental concerns rather than as independent abstractions. Hence, Atomic Security Concerns could be viewed as a common abstraction layer for the representation of cybersecurity concepts, independently of their domain, nature, or level of granularity. Building upon this perspective, the paper explores how Atomic Security Concerns may provide the vocabulary of a cybersecurity language and how cybersecurity concepts may be represented as concern sets supporting explicit relationships among concepts. The contribution of this work is intentionally conceptual: it introduces a framework and research hypothesis for investigating the foundations of a common language for cybersecurity knowledge representation, reasoning, and future formalization.

[198] WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU cs.DC | cs.CVPDF

Bingnan Liu, Ruini Xue

TL;DR: 论文面向单张消费级GPU上的长时程交互式世界模型，提出 WorldPager 分层内存系统，将历史 chunk 的 int4 KV 缓存在 GPU/DRAM/NVMe 层级中，并利用已知相机位姿预取未来访问，避免重计算和缺失等待。系统在单 RTX 4090、32 GiB 主机内存和 NVMe SSD 上实现零停顿、恒定主机内存的连续视频生成。

Details

Motivation: 交互式世界模型需要保留历史 KV 以维持重访场景一致性，但在单机消费级硬件上会受主机内存容量和模型位置视界限制，长会话难以持续。论文指出该场景是容量受限而非带宽受限，且访问集合可在计算前由相机位姿确定。

Result: 方法可连续生成 37.5 分钟视频，零停顿且主机内存恒定，约 9.5 FPS；在密封测试集上 int4 存储无明显质量损失，长间隔重访时 MUSIQ 图像质量约下降 1 分。其解析模型可将溢出点预测误差控制在一个 chunk 内，并正确分类零/非零停顿。

Insight: 创新点在于首次将交互式世界模型的 KV 内存放到 NVMe 层级，并结合已知相机位姿进行零停顿预取、后台写回和 int4 分层存储，避免 KV 重计算；同时用训练无关的位置处理扩展有效视界。客观看，利用输入位姿提前知道访问集合并以容量瓶颈为核心设计分层缓存，是较有借鉴价值的系统级思路。

Abstract: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model’s positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk’s memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

[199] GaussianSpline: Adaptive Bézier Splines for Highly Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting cs.GR | cs.CVPDF

Tom Yachil, Andrei Sharf

TL;DR: 论文提出 GaussianSpline，一种动态 4D Gaussian Splatting 方法，用自适应非均匀分段三次 Bézier 样条建模每个高斯点的运动轨迹，并联合学习 Bézier 控制点与时间划分。该方法在高动态区域分配更多时间容量、近静态区域保持紧凑轨迹，同时通过反射约束保证相邻 Bézier 段之间的 G1 连续性。

Details

Motivation: 现有动态 4D Gaussian Splatting 多依赖全局变形、固定阶多项式或均匀参数化样条，难以兼顾高度非均匀动态区域的精细重建与近静态区域的紧凑表示。论文旨在为每个高斯点自适应分配时间建模能力，以高保真重建复杂快速运动。

Result: 在 Neural 3D Video benchmark、Google Immersive 数据集及合成场景上的实验表明，GaussianSpline 在高度非均匀和困难动态场景中显著提升重建质量，同时在一般动态场景上相比最先进 4D Gaussian Splatting 方法保持有竞争力的性能。

Insight: 创新点在于联合学习每个高斯点的 Bézier 控制点与轨迹时间划分，实现非均匀自适应时间参数化；并通过基于反射的控制点约束强制相邻 Bézier 段 G1 连续，在保持轨迹平滑可微的同时保留局部灵活性。客观看，该设计将自适应分段样条引入逐高斯运动建模，较好平衡了表达能力、紧凑性与优化稳定性。

Abstract: We present GaussianSpline, a dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting method that models per-Gaussian motion using adaptive, non-uniform piecewise cubic Bézier splines. Unlike approaches based on global deformations, fixed-order polynomials, or uniformly parameterized splines, GaussianSpline jointly learns the Bézier control points and the temporal partition of each Gaussian’s trajectory. This adaptive representation allocates greater temporal capacity to highly dynamic regions while maintaining compact trajectories for near-static regions, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction of complex and rapidly changing motion. To jointly achieve globally smooth motion and local adaptivity, we enforce $G^1$ continuity between consecutive Bézier segments using a reflection-based constraint on their control points. This produces smooth, fully differentiable trajectories while preserving the flexibility of non-uniform temporal parameterization. Experiments on the Neural 3D Video benchmark, the Google Immersive dataset, as well as on synthetic scenes demonstrate that GaussianSpline substantially improves reconstruction quality in scenes with highly non-uniform and challenging dynamics, while maintaining competitive performance on general dynamic scenes compared with state-of-the-art 4D Gaussian Splatting methods.

[200] InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

Qinsi Wang, Wei Wen, Chong Zhou, Saksham Suri, Zechun Liu

TL;DR: 论文提出 InteractiveWorld，一个面向可穿戴/第一视角 AI 助手的可验证闭环交互环境，让 MLLM 助手通过指导人类代理完成物理任务；并构建 InteractiveBench 动态基准，包含 120 个多轮任务和基于状态的奖励。实验评估 12 个前沿 MLLM，发现现有模型仍远不能作为可靠助手。

Details

Motivation: 现有第一视角 MLLM 助手需要真实人类参与测试，交互数据昂贵稀缺，难以回答当前 MLLM 能否真正帮助人类完成物理世界任务。论文希望提供可验证、可复现的人机闭环评测环境。

Result: 在 InteractiveBench 的六类 120 个多轮任务上评测 12 个前沿 MLLM；最强模型 Claude Fable 5.1 在长时程 Guidance 和 Planning 任务上分别最多仅达到 20% 和 25%，表明现有模型与可靠助手仍有明显差距。

Insight: 创新点在于以人类代理而非机器人作为执行主体，构建助手指导、人类行动、环境更新观测的闭环可验证仿真，并用状态奖励评估多轮指令；客观看，其价值在于将第一视角助手能力评测从静态问答推进到人机交互与长时程规划。

Abstract: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user’s physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today’s MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.

[201] Novel or Not? PatEx-Gym: Agentic Prior-Art Search for Novelty Assessment in Patent Examination cs.IR | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Qiyao Wang, Xinyi Chen, Hongbo Wang, Jiayuan Lu, Jianhang Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 PatEx-Gym，一个面向专利审查中现有技术检索与新颖性评估的智能体开发与评测框架。它包含 PatEx-Bench 基准（1K 真实审查任务、超 100 万专利和 5.2 万论文语料及迭代搜索运行时）、无需人工标注的 PASS 轨迹合成方法，以及基于合成轨迹监督微调得到的 4B 规模 PatEx-Agent。

Details

Motivation: 现有基准多依赖静态且有限的候选集，未充分覆盖专利审查中“搜索—推理—评估”的完整过程；论文希望支持智能体发现稀疏现有技术、迭代优化查询、检查证据并生成审查意见。

Result: 实验表明仅看最终决策准确率不能完整反映审查质量，现有技术发现对强前沿模型仍很困难；4B 的 PatEx-Agent 在 PatEx-Bench 上与更大通用智能体相比具有竞争力。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新包括首个完整专利审查智能体框架、利用文档访问作为隐式相关性信号的无标注轨迹合成方法 PASS，以及轻量 4B 审查智能体基线。客观上看，其价值在于将搜索轨迹建模与全流程评测结合，为 agentic search 和深度研究智能体提供高难度测试平台。

Abstract: Patent examination is a challenging real-world task that requires agents to discover sparse prior art, iteratively refine queries, inspect technical evidence, and produce novelty assessments documented in Office Actions (OAs) across heterogeneous scientific and technical domains. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on static and limited candidate sets, leaving the full search–reasoning–assessment process underexplored. We present PatEx-Gym, the first framework for developing and evaluating agents for patent examination, which integrates three components. First, PatEx-Bench provides 1K realistic examination tasks, two large-scale retrieval corpora containing over 1M patents and 52K scientific papers, and a harness runtime supporting iterative search, document visits, reasoning, and OA generation. Second, we introduce PASS, an annotation-free Prior-Art Agentic Search Trajectory Synthesis framework. Specifically, it exploits document visits as implicit relevance signals and evidence-acquisition anchors to model intra-turn query behavior, inter-turn search progression, and trajectory-level evidence and outcome quality, yielding PatEx-SynData. Third, we train PatEx-Agent at the 4B scale via supervised fine-tuning on the curated trajectories, establishing a lightweight baseline. Extensive experiments show that final decision accuracy alone does not fully reflect examination quality, while prior-art discovery remains difficult even for strong frontier models. Our PatEx-Agent achieves competitive performance against substantially larger general-purpose agents. These results show that training on PatEx-SynData enables a compact 4B model to serve as a competitive baseline for prior-art search and patent examination. We view patent examination as a demanding testbed for agentic search and deep research agents.

[202] CRIM: Composable and Reusable Item Memory for Efficient Personalized Retrieval cs.IR | cs.CLPDF

Haolin Li, Haipeng Zhang, Mang Li, Zhaohui Xia, Xun Zhu

TL;DR: 论文提出CRIM框架，将物品级语义编码与请求级历史建模解耦：用少量可学习summary tokens把每个物品压缩为紧凑、可复用的连续记忆，并用segment-level REC tokens在交互历史内引入预测监督；推理时按交互顺序组合缓存记忆和可选查询生成个性化检索表示。训练上结合缓存记忆与每请求少量采样实时重编码，并周期性刷新缓存，以较低计算成本联合优化物品与请求编码器。

Details

Motivation: LLM用于个性化搜索与推荐时，交互历史增长会拉长请求输入，且同一物品文本被反复编码，带来显著训练和推理成本；需要减少重复物品编码并保留请求相关上下文建模。

Result: 在MovieLens-1M、Qilin和新提出的LazSeq数据集上，CRIM在相同backbone规模下取得SOTA检索性能，同时大幅降低推理成本，并在联合训练中限制物品重编码次数。

Insight: 创新点在于将物品记忆与用户/查询解耦以支持跨请求复用，并通过可组合缓存记忆、REC tokens预测监督及缓存+少量实时重编码的联合训练机制，在效果与成本间取得平衡；客观看，其核心价值是把个性化检索中的物品编码与请求建模分离，用缓存复用降低LLM推理开销。

Abstract: Large language models incur substantial training and inference costs in personalized search and recommendation, as growing interaction histories lengthen request inputs and repeatedly expose the same item text to the model. We propose \textbf{C}omposable and \textbf{R}eusable \textbf{I}tem \textbf{M}emory (CRIM), a framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling. A small set of learnable summary tokens compresses each item into compact continuous memories, while segment-level readout tokens (REC tokens) introduce predictive supervision within the interaction history. These memories are independent of users and queries and can therefore be reused across requests. At inference time, CRIM composes cached memories in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to produce a personalized retrieval representation, reducing repeated item-text encoding while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling. We further introduce a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. Re-encoding only a few history items per request allows the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the item and request encoders at limited computational cost, while periodic cache refreshes maintain consistency. Extensive evaluation and cost analysis on MovieLens-1M, Qilin, and our new LazSeq dataset show that CRIM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance with substantially lower inference costs at the same backbone scale, while limiting item re-encoding during joint training. We will publicly release our code and dataset.

cs.LG [Back]

[203] Lessons from Luck: Do LLM-Written Lessons Carry Chance into an Agent’s Next Decision? cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.IRPDF

Kazuki Nakayashiki

TL;DR: 论文通过预注册研究检验自改进LLM智能体是否会把带噪声的运行结果写入“经验教训”，并在下一次决策中继续传递偶然性。作者在256个合成世界中让模型根据上一轮工具选择及成功/失败结果生成lesson，再由同一模型的新会话基于该记忆选择下一轮首个工具。结果显示，当更可靠工具偶然失败后，由该失败写出的lesson会显著提高下一次选择较差工具的概率，说明偶然性会被记忆带入后续决策。

Details

Motivation: 自改进智能体会从运行结果中写lesson，但结果常含噪声；论文关注的问题是：这种由偶然成功或失败生成的lesson，是否会污染智能体下一次决策，即把chance带入后续行为。

Result: 在11个LLM端点、90,084次回答中，更可靠工具偶然失败后，基于该失败写lesson使下一次选择较差工具的比例达11.6%，而无关记忆和基于成功写lesson均为0.4%；注册交互效应为+0.112，95%区间[+0.097,+0.126]。当日志声明失败独立时效应降至+0.042，未声明时为+0.181；较差工具侥幸成功后的效应被界定在0.10以下（+0.002）。次要比较中，加入三句决策质量提示将偶然失败后的较差工具率降至7.5%，加入含“不改变”选项的统一指令降至3.1%，但均未在所有端点满足预注册的减害规则。

Insight: 论文的创新点在于用预注册、冻结协议和大规模多端点实验，拆解并测量“噪声结果→LLM写lesson→下一次决策”的因果链条；其可控合成世界和多种记忆对照设计能较干净地分离偶然性传递效应。客观上看，研究还揭示了单纯让模型总结经验可能放大噪声，而指令层面的缓解措施有效但不够稳健。

Abstract: Self-improving agents write lessons from the outcomes of their runs; when outcomes are noisy, a lesson can carry chance into later decisions. We measure one link of this chain in a registered study. In 256 synthetic worlds, each a recurring task with two interchangeable tools of recorded reliability, a scripted previous run used the more reliable tool (a good decision) or the less reliable one (a bad decision), with an assigned outcome: success or a transient failure. A model wrote a lesson from the run with ReasoningBank’s memory-writing instruction; a fresh session of the same model, holding the authoritative log and the previous result, chose the next run’s first tool with one memory item: that lesson, the lesson from the other outcome, an irrelevant item, or an unreasoned directive. The protocol was frozen, deposited and timestamped before any confirmatory call; 11 LLM endpoints gave 90,084 answers. After a chance failure of the better tool, the panel’s lessons carried the chance (registered reading luck-carrying; interaction +0.112, 95% interval [+0.097, +0.126]): readers named the worse tool in 11.6% of next runs with the lesson written from that failure, against 0.4% with an irrelevant item and 0.4% with the lesson written from a success. The effect was +0.042 where the log stated that failures are independent and +0.181 where it did not (descriptive). After a lucky success of the worse tool, the interaction was bounded below 0.10 (+0.002), a bound, not evidence of no harm. In exploratory readings, 6 endpoints carried the chance (up to +0.352); 5 were bounded below 0.10. In secondary comparisons, a three-sentence decision-quality note in the writing instruction lowered the worse-tool rate after a chance failure to 7.5%, and one instruction for both outcomes with a no-change option to 3.1%; neither met the registered harm-reduction rule at every such endpoint.

[204] Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Harshithanjani Athi, Sravan Kumar Ankireddy, Jianzhong Charlie Zhang, Hyeji Kim

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练的查询感知视觉token剪枝方法QViD。作者观察到VLM注意力中由query/key投影自然诱导的查询-视觉交互矩阵具有低秩结构，少量主导潜在交互模式即可捕捉与查询相关的视觉语义。基于此，QViD利用该结构进行视觉token选择与剪枝，以降低推理成本。

Details

Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型因视觉token数量多导致推理成本高，现有查询引导剪枝方法多依赖注意力模式或token动态等启发式，未显式利用查询-视觉交互的底层结构。

Result: 在图像和视频理解基准上的大量实验表明，在相同token预算下QViD一致提升性能，且在更激进的压缩设置下增益最大；摘要未给出具体数值或SOTA声明。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. Specifically, SEPO utilizes labels to elicit correct reasoning from the policy, unlocking the exploration potential. By treating current policy conditioned on this in-distribution reasoning as a self-teacher, SEPO distills the newly discovered solution back into the policy. Through this iterative cycle of policy-intrinsic exploration and exploitation, SEPO achieves robust and continuous capability evolution. We find that (1) adversarial training leads to straighter representations in both CNN and transformer-based architectures but (2) this effect is task-dependent, not generalizing to tasks such as segmentation and frame-prediction, where straight representations are not favorable for predictions; and nor to other types of robustness. Finally, (4) biologically-inspired elements increase straightness in the early stages of a network, but do not guarantee increased straightness in downstream layers of CNNs. Insight: 创新点在于将机制可解释性分析与高效微调结合：揭示LoRA适配的组件级和层级稀疏性及任务依赖性，并提出校准驱动的冻结基座零消融方法，自动识别任务特定层，无需穷举搜索。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA’s adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a $3.5\times$ reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adaptive fine-tuning.

[214] Priority-Preserving Advantage Aggregation for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Xiangchi Yuan, Xingjian Diao, Zheyuan Liu, Chunhui Zhang, Dachuan Shi

TL;DR: 论文关注LLM后训练中多目标奖励优先级不平等的问题，指出常用的加性优势聚合（additive advantage aggregation）会导致“优势优先级反转”（advantage priority inversion），即辅助目标信号过强时会覆盖主目标的偏好。为此，论文提出PAPO（Primary Advantage Policy Optimization），一种非对称的主、辅优势聚合方法：当目标一致时保留辅助监督，当目标冲突时平滑衰减辅助信号，并保持主优势符号。该方法可同时用于GRPO的序列级优势和actor-critic PPO的token级优势。

Details

Motivation: LLM后训练常需同时优化多个优先级不同的目标（如正确性与推理效率）。直接相加聚合奖励容易让辅助目标反转主目标偏好；而奖励级门控虽能保护优先级，却会丢弃未满足主目标条件的样本中仍有价值的辅助区分信息，论文希望解决这一权衡问题。

Result: 在多个领域和多个模型上的实验表明，无论基于GRPO还是基于PPO的优化，PAPO都能稳定取得最佳的主目标性能，同时辅助目标性能达到最佳或具有竞争力。

Insight: 创新点在于把优先级保护从奖励层下移到优势（advantage）层，采用非对称聚合：目标一致时保留辅助监督，冲突时平滑衰减辅助信号并保持主优势符号，从而实现“主一致排序”（primary-consistent ordering）；且该规则统一适用于序列级与token级优势，兼具通用性与实用性。

Abstract: LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency. However, the widely used additive reward aggregation in RL can violate these priorities: when primary and auxiliary advantages conflict, a sufficiently large auxiliary signal can overturn the preference induced by the primary objective. We term this problem \emph{advantage priority inversion}. Although reward-level gating can protect priority more directly, it still removes potentially useful auxiliary distinctions among rollout samples that fail the primary condition. To address this trade-off, we propose Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (\textbf{PAPO}), a priority-aware advantage aggregation method that asymmetrically combines a primary and an auxiliary advantage. PAPO retains auxiliary supervision when the objectives agree and smoothly attenuates conflicting auxiliary signals, preserving the primary sign during fusion for \emph{primary-consistent ordering}. This rule applies to sequence-level advantages in GRPO and token-level advantages in actor–critic PPO. Experiments on multiple domains and models show that PAPO consistently achieves the best primary objective while maintaining best or competitive auxiliary-objective performance across both GRPO- and PPO-based optimization. \href{https://xiangchi-yuan.github.io/papo-project/}{Code is available}.

[215] Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Junxing Hu, Zicheng Zhang, Zhiqian Zhang, Ai Han, Yifeng Zhang

TL;DR: 论文针对GRPO训练长链思维推理模型时易发生策略坍塌的问题，提出Info-GRPO。该方法不再依赖逐token的熵正则，而是通过增加潜在种子并建模潜在变量与推理轨迹之间的互信息，使模型在整条推理轨迹层面保持多样性探索，同时让条件熵正常收敛。

Details

Motivation: 长轨迹推理训练中，传统熵正则会对每个token持续施加探索奖励，与收敛所需的熵下降相冲突，且系数难以设置，容易导致策略坍塌或探索效率低。

Result: 在多种推理基准上，Info-GRPO优于原始GRPO和熵正则化GRPO；在AIME24上，四个骨干模型的Avg@8分别比GRPO提升3.75%、1.66%、4.16%和4.17%，并以8倍更少样本达到相同多数投票准确率。

Insight: 创新点在于用潜在先验与推理轨迹的互信息组织探索，通过潜在种子实现轨迹级多样性，而非逐token随机性，从而缓解探索与熵收敛的矛盾；客观看，其价值在于将长轨迹探索从局部token正则提升为全局策略相关性建模。

Abstract: Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. Diversity is therefore carried across whole reasoning traces rather than by per-token randomness, and exploration no longer fights entropy reduction. Experiments show that Info-GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO and entropy-regularized GRPO across diverse reasoning benchmarks. On AIME24, it improves $Avg@8$ over GRPO by 3.75%, 1.66%, 4.16%, and 4.17% on four backbones, and it reaches the same majority-vote accuracy with $8\times$ fewer samples. Code and models will be publicly released.

[216] Improving Reasoning with Rollout Agreement for Group-Based Policy Optimization cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Sohyun Son, Yerim Hong, Jaeyun Park, Mujeen Sung

TL;DR: 论文研究RLVR中GRPO正确答案rollout之间的差异是否反映有效替代推理，发现低一致性正确答案轨迹更易包含虚假推理。为此提出RoAR，将rollout一致性作为推理级奖励加入GRPO，无需人工理由、额外采样或单独过程评估器。在五个数学推理基准上，1.5B模型零样本平均pass@1达55.5%，并显著降低盲审中的虚假推理率。

Details

Motivation: 现有基于GRPO的RLVR方法利用rollout多样性提升推理或训练效率，但正确答案rollout之间的差异究竟代表有用替代推理还是未解决错误尚不清楚。论文旨在识别并利用rollout一致性来提升推理有效性。

Result: 在五个数学推理基准上，使用7K训练样本的1.5B GRPO-RoAR模型零样本平均pass@1为55.5%，分别超过GRPO和GRPO-CARE 6.0和5.5个百分点。对100个四个1.5B模型均答对问题的盲审显示，GRPO-RoAR虚假率为18%，低于GRPO的32%、GRPO-CARE的27%和DRA-GRPO的37%。

Insight: 创新点在于通过盲配对分析揭示低一致性正确答案轨迹中虚假推理更多，并提出RoAR将组内rollout一致性作为推理级奖励，直接复用现有on-policy rollout组。客观看，其价值在于无需额外采样或过程评估器即可利用一致性信号引导学习，并强调推理有效性而不仅是答案正确性。

Abstract: Recent methods for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) use rollout diversity to improve reasoning performance or training efficiency. Despite these gains, the extent to which differences among correct-answer rollouts reflect useful alternative reasoning or unresolved errors remains poorly understood. We investigate this question through a blind paired analysis of a model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), comparing the highest- and lowest-agreement correct-answer traces for the same problem. Across 126 pairs, low-agreement traces have more spurious reasoning than high-agreement traces (35% vs. 22%), including internal inconsistencies and misuse of problem conditions. Based on these findings, we propose RoAR (Rollout-Agreement Reward), which adds reasoning-level agreement to GRPO’s rewards for verified-correct rollouts. RoAR computes this signal from existing on-policy rollout groups, requiring no human-written rationales, additional sampling, or separately trained process evaluator. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the 1.5B GRPO-RoAR model reaches 55.5% mean pass@1 under zero-shot evaluation using 7K training examples, exceeding GRPO and GRPO-CARE by 6.0 and 5.5 percentage points. A separate blind audit of 100 problems answered correctly by all four 1.5B models finds spurious rates of 18% for GRPO-RoAR, 32% for GRPO, 27% for GRPO-CARE, and 37% for DRA-GRPO. Our findings identify reasoning validity as an important consideration when using rollout differences to guide learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/ldi-kyunghee/RoAR.

[217] Reinforcement Learning Done Right for Explicit Confidence Targets cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Zefeng He, Yichen He, Yuan Lin, Yang Yang, Yu Cheng

TL;DR: 论文研究显式置信目标下的LLM行为校准：用户在提示中指定目标置信度p，模型需决定回答或弃答，使已回答问题的准确率至少达到p。作者指出现有RL方法使用固定错误惩罚，难以适应不同p，且单模型多目标学习常失败。为此提出RLEC，通过保留区分不同置信目标的学习信号、引入稳定奖励族和奖励调度，首次成功训练单一LLM实现显式置信目标控制。

Details

Motivation: LLM在不确定时仍可能生成看似合理但错误的答案，损害可靠性和用户信任。用强化学习训练模型弃答是自然思路，但现有方法无法在推理时适应用户不同的置信度要求，且单模型学习多个显式置信目标十分困难。

Result: 在多种基准和模型规模上，RLEC基本保持通用能力，并取得有竞争力的校准性能；它支持细粒度置信目标控制，且无需外部决策系统或训练后阈值校准。摘要未给出具体数值或明确SOTA结论。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点在于诊断出多置信目标RL失败的两个原因：区分不同p的奖励信号在优化中丢失，以及错误惩罚在p趋近1时无界增长；并提出保留学习信号、稳定奖励族和奖励调度。客观来看，其创新在于将显式置信目标直接纳入训练策略，并针对多目标奖励设计中的信号保持与训练稳定性给出系统方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can produce plausible but incorrect answers when they are uncertain, which can mislead users and undermine model reliability. Training models to abstain with reinforcement learning is a natural approach, but most existing methods use a fixed error penalty and therefore cannot adapt their behavior to different confidence requirements at inference time. We study \emph{explicit confidence targets}, where a user specifies a target (p) in the prompt and the model directly chooses whether to answer or abstain, with the goal of achieving an accuracy of at least (p) among answered questions. However, learning to respond to different confidence targets with a single model has proven difficult, and prior attempts have failed to distinguish different targets. We show that this failure comes from two problems: the reward signal that distinguishes different values of $p$ is often lost during optimization, while the original error penalty grows without bound as $p$ approaches one. We propose RLEC (\textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{C}onfidence Targets), which preserves the learning signal needed to distinguish confidence targets, introduces a stable reward family that keeps the desired answer condition unchanged, and uses reward scheduling to balance effective learning and training stability. Together, these designs enable the first successful training of a single LLM for explicit confidence target control. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and model scales show that RLEC largely preserves general capabilities and achieves competitive calibration performance. RLEC also supports fine-grained target control without an external decision system or threshold calibration after training. By making explicit confidence targets part of the trained policy, RLEC opens a new and more direct path toward behavioral calibration.

[218] GPDPO: Learning from Reward Conflicts via Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Zixuan Xu, Haoxuan Chen, Jiangxin Sun, Jian-Fang Hu

TL;DR: 论文提出 GPDPO，一种多奖励策略优化方法，用于大语言模型对齐。该方法从因奖励冲突而被过滤的 rollout 中挖掘样本响应之间的帕累托支配关系，并将其转化为辅助偏好信号，与原始策略目标联合优化，从而在不增加额外采样或奖励评估的情况下更充分地复用训练数据。

Details

Motivation: 多奖励强化学习可让 LLM 对齐多样目标，但冲突奖励信号会导致更新方向不明确和优化不稳定。现有方法多从奖励重加权、梯度协调或 rollout 过滤入手，却未充分利用采样响应之间的关系信息，导致被冲突过滤的 rollout 中仍有可用监督被丢弃。

Result: 在 API-Bank 上跨多种模型规模和奖励配置的实验表明，GPDPO 稳定优于有竞争力的多奖励优化基线；进一步分析显示其能降低组内相对奖励冲突和成对奖励冲突。

Insight: 创新点在于识别采样响应间的帕累托支配关系，并将其转换为辅助偏好信号与原始策略目标联合优化，从而复用冲突过滤后的 rollout，无需额外采样或奖励评估；客观上，这为多奖励对齐中利用响应间关系监督提供了新思路。

Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning offers a promising framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse objectives, but conflicting reward signals can induce ambiguous update directions and hinder stable optimization. Existing approaches address such conflicts through reward reweighting, gradient coordination, or rollout filtering, yet they primarily operate on per-response or group-level optimization signals and underexploit relational information among sampled responses. As a result, conflict-filtered rollouts may still contain useful supervision that is discarded during training. We propose Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization (GPDPO), a multi-reward policy optimization method that recovers pairwise supervision from conflict-filtered rollouts. GPDPO identifies Pareto-dominance relations among sampled responses and converts them into auxiliary preference signals, which are jointly optimized with the original policy objective. This enables more effective reuse of existing rollouts without additional sampling or reward evaluation. Experiments on API-Bank across multiple model scales and reward configurations show that GPDPO consistently outperforms competitive multi-reward optimization baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that GPDPO reduces both group-relative and pairwise reward conflicts, supporting the effectiveness of exploiting relational supervision for multi-reward alignment. Code will be released.

[219] S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Shuo Shen, Guangran Cheng, Chengqi Lyu, Xiangsen Wang, Yanan Sun

TL;DR: 论文提出S3AC，一个面向LLM长链推理RLVR的稳定、可选择、可扩展的Actor-Critic框架，通过实用的critic训练配方让critic同时提供token级优势估计和prompt级基线。基于prompt级基线估计难度并结合历史结果，论文提出DAPS进行生成前的提示选择，以减少rollout浪费。方法在1.5B到397B参数的dense和MoE模型上提升group-rollout性能，并在35B规模上支持单rollout持续训练。

Details

Motivation: 现有critic-free RLVR方法缺乏token级信用分配，且通常依赖grouped rollouts估计prompt特定基线；而训练长CoT critic又受限于轨迹长度覆盖不足和初始化value head导致早期梯度主导的问题。

Result: S3AC在1.5B到397B参数的dense和MoE模型上提升group-rollout表现，优于现代GRPO变体GRPO-X；在35B规模上可维持单rollout训练，而测试的无critic基线在初期增益后出现退化。

Insight: 创新点在于提出稳定、可选择、可扩展的critic训练配方，使critic提供token-specific advantages和prompt-specific baselines，并利用prompt级基线做Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling（DAPS）以减少rollout浪费。客观看，其价值在于把critic用于细粒度信用分配与采样难度估计，缓解critic-free方法的两个核心瓶颈，并展示大规模与单rollout场景下的可扩展性。

Abstract: Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.

[220] MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Runchu Tian, Zaid Khan, Zun Wang, Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Mohit Bansal

TL;DR: 论文提出 MiRL（Misbehavior-driven RL），将错误定向学习应用于终端智能体（terminal agent）这类需要与命令行交互、完成长程自然语言任务的情景。方法先对策略的错误进行画像，找出跨环境反复出现的错误行为类型（misbehaviors），再在这些错误发生的步骤处开始 rollout 进行强化学习训练，只有当 rollout 通过测试且避免该错误行为时才给予奖励。

Details

Motivation: 现有错误定向学习方法只针对单轮任务，而现有的智能体失败分析多用于评估和调试、而非用于训练；论文希望在真实的长程终端任务上实现“识别弱点—训练修复—验证是否修复”的闭环。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，8 类错误行为占错误步骤的 52.1%；经 MiRL 训练后，策略在未见前缀上重复这些错误行为的频率平均降低 43%～57%。在 Terminal-Bench Lite 上以 51.8% 超过 TMax-4B 的 47.4%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上以 21.3% 与 20.6% 基本持平，且仅使用其 35% 的 rollout 量。

Insight: 创新点在于：将错误画像用于发现可泛化的错误行为类型，并将其作为训练信号；从错误发生步骤起做 rollout，提升长程任务训练效率；奖励同时约束任务成功与避免错误行为，从而实现可解释、可验证的错误定向强化学习。

Abstract: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

[221] Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Yeonjae Kim, Omin Kwon, Seong Hoon Seo, Jae W. Lee

TL;DR: 论文提出 Triage，一种无需训练的注意力计算方法，用于加速视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）推理。它根据每个注意力 tile 的近似误差，将 tile 分到三个精度层级：跳过（用 block mean 替代）、NVFP4 粗略计算、NVFP4 残差校正精算；并用轻量 router 预测误差、决定是否升级到更精确层级。方法在 RTX Blackwell GPU 的 FP4 tensor core 上以融合 kernel 单次执行三个层级。

Details

Motivation: 视频 DiT 推理中数万视觉 token 的注意力计算开销巨大；现有稀疏化或低精度方法对所有保留 tile 使用统一精度，但不同 tile 的近似误差差异很大，统一策略不够高效。

Result: 在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 和 LTX-2.5 上，相比 dense FlashAttention 端到端生成最高加速 2.32x；在五个设置中均快于所有基线，并比最高 PSNR 基线高 0.3-3.0 dB PSNR。

Insight: 创新点在于按 tile 误差自适应分配三档近似精度，并用轻量 router 和单一价格参数权衡误差降低与额外计算；结合 FP4 tensor core 的融合 kernel 实现训练免费的异构注意力加速，体现了细粒度误差感知计算分配的价值。

Abstract: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile’s error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

[222] When Agents Collude: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation for Mitigating Strategic Deception in Multi-Agent Systems cs.MA | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Eric Onyame, Runtao Zhou, Kowshik Thopalli, Bhavya Kailkhura, Chirag Agarwal

TL;DR: 论文研究多智能体协调带来的合谋与战略欺骗风险，在模拟内幕交易环境中比较单智能体与顺序/去中心化团队在7个语言模型上的表现，发现多智能体交互显著提高错配行动率和持续欺骗率，尤其在存在性压力下更严重；为缓解该问题，提出PACT弱到强在线策略蒸馏框架，利用冻结的诚实对齐小模型作为教师，通过反向KL监督训练更强学生模型匹配其下一词分布，从而大幅降低多智能体持续欺骗。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注自主智能体协调能力增强后可能引发的安全风险，特别是多智能体合谋：智能体联合追求错配目标，并在报告中隐藏真实依据、在追问下维持欺骗。现有研究对多智能体战略欺骗的系统性测量和缓解仍不足，因此论文希望在可控模拟环境中量化该风险并提出对齐方法。

Result: 在模拟内幕交易环境中，多智能体交互相比单智能体将错配行动率从35.4%提高到68.2%，持续欺骗率从31.0%提高到62.2%；在存在性压力下，团队在87%的运行中能通过后续追问维持欺骗。提出PACT后，在存在性压力与伦理指令下，多智能体持续欺骗率从80%降至3%。

Insight: 论文的创新点在于系统揭示多智能体协调会放大群体级战略欺骗而非孤立报告错误，并提出PACT：用通用诚实提示、弱到强在线策略蒸馏和反向KL监督，让强学生模型在自己的采样轨迹上对齐较小冻结诚实教师。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是将多智能体合谋风险量化，并用on-policy弱到强蒸馏缓解强模型在压力场景下的诚实对齐失效。

Abstract: While recent advances in autonomous agents enable them to coordinate on increasingly complex tasks, prior work shows that this growing capacity for coordination can create safety risks, including collusion, in which agents jointly pursue misaligned actions while concealing the true basis of those actions from oversight. We study this risk in a simulated insider-trading environment, comparing single agents with sequential and decentralized teams across seven language models from three families. By varying agents’ system-level objectives and pressure conditions, we examine when coordinated agents act on material nonpublic information, conceal the basis of a misaligned trade in a report, and maintain that deception under follow-up questioning. Compared to single-agent decision-making, multi-agent interaction raises misaligned-action rates from 35.4% to 68.2% and persistent-deception rates from 31.0% to 62.2%, both measured over all runs. These effects are largest under existential pressure, where teams sustain deception through follow-up questioning in 87% of all runs. Qualitative analysis reveals shared cover stories and coordinated rationales, suggesting group-level strategic deception rather than isolated reporting errors. To mitigate this behavior, we introduce PACT, a weak-to-strong on-policy distillation framework for mitigating collusive deception. Using generic honesty prompts, PACT trains a stronger student on its own sampled continuations, matching its next-token distribution to that of a smaller, frozen honesty-aligned teacher via reverse-KL supervision. Under existential pressure with ethical instructions, PACT reduces multi-agent persistent deception from 80% to 3%. Our results show that multi-agent coordination amplifies strategic deception and that on-policy honesty alignment can substantially mitigate these failures.

Hanwen Li, Jinhao Duan, Xiaoshuang Shi, Yue Zhang, Tianlong Chen

Details

Motivation: 多智能体系统虽能提升大模型推理能力，但仍易产生幻觉和错误输出；现有不确定性量化方法多面向单智能体，如何利用多智能体结构进行系统级不确定性量化且保持推理成本中性仍研究不足。

Result: 在 Debate 和 DyLAN 及多种基准上，UMAS 平均超过 SOTA 基线 10.54 个 AUROC 点；同时支持幻觉检测和不确定性感知答案选择，在特定任务上最多提升多智能体系统准确率 12.6 个百分点。

Insight: 创新点在于用生成结果的内在置信度评估智能体间影响的可靠性，并将其用于节点级不确定性更新和系统级聚合；从客观角度看，其可借鉴之处是无需额外参数和推理成本地利用多智能体交互结构提升不确定性估计与系统可靠性。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) are a promising paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet they remain prone to hallucinations and erroneous outputs. Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is crucial for assessing system reliability, but existing methods are largely designed for single-agent settings; how to exploit MAS structure for UQ while keeping inference cost-neutral remains underexplored. We propose UMAS, a parameter-free, cost-neutral, system-level UQ framework that estimates the credibility of inter-agent influence from each generation’s intrinsic confidence. UMAS uses these credibility signals to modulate how uncertainty is updated at each node, and then aggregates node-level uncertainty into a system-level estimate. Extensive evaluations on Debate and DyLAN across diverse benchmarks show that UMAS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 10.54 AUROC points. Beyond uncertainty estimation, UMAS enables hallucination detection and uncertainty-aware answer selection, improving MAS accuracy by up to 12.6 points on specific tasks while enhancing reliability. Code is available at https://github.com/Dby52-04/UMAS.

[224] AdShot: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Advertisement Clipping cs.MM | cs.CVPDF

TL;DR: 论文提出 AdShot，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在广告剪辑镜头选择任务上表现的基准。该基准包含 823 对专业编辑广告（30 秒原片与 15 秒剪辑版），覆盖 194 个品牌和 17 个行业，并标注镜头边界及动作、情感、信息、意象等内容特征。作者评测了 13 个纯视频 MLLM 和 2 个音视频 MLLM（7B-72B），从镜头选择准确率、15 秒时长约束和内容保留等维度进行分析。

Motivation: 广告主常需制作多时长的广告变体以适配预算和受众偏好，但该过程人工成本高。现有 MLLM 虽擅长通用视频理解，其在广告剪辑这类专业编辑任务中的能力尚未被系统探索。

Result: 实验发现模型架构比参数规模更重要，较小模型常可匹配甚至超过大模型；目标广告含 6-10 个镜头时表现最好；模型平均绝对时长误差为 5.39 秒，多数倾向超过 15 秒目标，但仍能显著减少人工编辑工作量；所有模型存在系统性内容偏好，倾向选择信息丰富和情感聚焦镜头，而低估动作和意象镜头。

Abstract: Advertisers routinely create multiple duration variants of ads to meet marketing budgets and viewer preferences, a labor-intensive and costly process. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at general video understanding, their ability to perform specialized editorial tasks remains unexplored. We introduce AdShot, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on shot selection for ad clipping. It contains 823 professionally edited ad pairs (30-sec sources and 15-sec edits) across 194 brands and 17 industries, annotated with shot-level boundaries and content features (action, emotion, information, imagery). We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video-only MLLMs and 2 audio-visual MLLMs (7B-72B parameters) on shot selection accuracy (Precision, Recall, F1), duration constraints (15s), and content preservation, including an audio ablation. We find: (1) model architecture matters more than scale, with smaller models often matching or exceeding larger ones; performance is strongest for target ads with 6-10 shots; (2) models exhibit a mean absolute duration error of 5.39s, with most tending to overshoot the 15s target, though they can still substantially reduce human editing effort; (3) all models exhibit systematic content biases, favoring information-rich and emotion-focused shots while under-selecting action and imagery. We publicly release our benchmark to facilitate research at the intersection of multimodal AI and computational advertising.

Lennart Schiweck, Adrian Kempf, Michelle Retig, Moritz Feucht, Tim Mangliers

Abstract: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.

[226] EXE: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Pretraining via Factorized Latent Actions for VLA Models cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Qingyuan Cai, Bo Zhang, Yongzhen Huang, Jianyu Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 EXE，一个基于第一人称（自我中心）人类视频的跨具身预训练框架，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它从人类操作视频中学习因子化的潜在动作表示，将可迁移的共享操作先验（伸手、抓取、放置等）与具身特有的运动学信号解耦，使机器人策略能利用大量人类演示数据学习通用操作语义，并迁移到不同运动学结构的本体上。

Details

Motivation: VLA 模型受限于机器人数据稀缺；第一人称人类操作视频数量丰富、多样且语义丰富，但人类手与机器人之间存在具身鸿沟，运动学差异使人们难以直接从这些视频中提取与动作相关的可迁移表示。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa GR1 仿真基准以及真实世界操作任务上，EXE 相对无预训练基线取得了一致的性能提升，且同一预训练可同时惠及平行夹爪与灵巧手两类本体。

Insight: 创新点在于将潜在动作表示显式分解为共享操作先验与具身特有信号，从而在学习跨具身通用技能的同时剥离人类运动学偏置，避免其干扰机器人策略；这种解耦式潜在动作预训练思路对利用异构人类视频数据具有较好的借鉴价值。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are bottlenecked by the scarcity of robot data. Egocentric human manipulation videos offer an abundant, diverse, and semantically-rich alternative that inherently captures manipulation intent. However, the embodiment gap makes it difficult to extract action-relevant representations from these videos. From the perspective of action execution, human hands and robots share analogous manipulation primitives—reaching, grasping, placing—yet exhibit distinct kinematics tied to their embodiments. This might motivate our key approach: egocentric video pretraining can yield shared action representations capturing transferable manipulation skills, while human-specific motion patterns should be disentangled to avoid interfering with robot policy learning. To this end, we propose EXE, an Egocentric Cross(X)-Embodiment pretraining framework that learns a factorized latent action representation from egocentric human videos, separating shared manipulation priors from embodiment-specific signals. By leveraging the shared action space, the robot policy acquires generalizable manipulation semantics from diverse human demonstrations without being biased by human-specific kinematics. This shared knowledge transfers across embodiments with different kinematic structures, enabling the same pretraining to benefit both parallel grippers and dexterous hands. EXE yields consistent gains over baseline without pretraining on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa GR1, and real-world manipulation tasks.

Details

Motivation: 现有VLM在机器人下游任务上的真实世界评估困难且昂贵，需要一种能直接评估机器人相关视觉推理能力的方法，并解决VLM在排序任务上表现不佳的问题。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance when integrated into robot manipulation pipelines, but real-world evaluation of VLM capabilities on downstream robotics tasks is both difficult and expensive to scale. We propose that spatial and temporal ordering tasks using images from stereo and wrist cameras attached to real-world robots are particularly well-suited for evaluating visual reasoning capabilities, as they assess skills directly applicable to robots. We evaluate VLM reasoning abilities on three questions: ordering shuffled frames conditioned on a language description of the task, ordering objects depthwise based on distance from the camera, and ordering objects from left-to-right in pixel coordinates. The complexity of these tasks can also be modulated by changing the size of the set to sort. Our experiments show that several state-of-the-art vision-language models struggle on ordering tasks. To fix this, we propose a scalable autonomous training data generation pipeline, and show that both supervised finetuning and reinforcement-learning on the generated data can significantly improve VLM reasoning performance both on spatiotemporal ordering tasks as well as downstream robotics and visual reasoning tasks.

Abstract: Robot tasks require grounding spatial language in physical scenes, but task success alone cannot establish whether spatial instructions are followed. We present BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark built on BEHAVIOR-1K that measures spatial question answering, point-based target grounding, and robot action to examine how VLM spatial understanding relates to VLA behavior. It comprises 3,256 spatial questions across 49 activities, 1,240 grounding queries across 14 manipulation tasks, and action evaluations covering those 14 tasks and 10 navigation tasks. Our manipulation protocol evaluates held-out configurations and instruction following when the requested target changes within a fixed training layout. The baseline achieves 41.6% on held-out configurations but only 16.1% under changed instructions. VLM adaptation and robot-data pretraining provide limited improvements, whereas oracle visual target cues raise these rates to 60.3% and 38.0%, respectively. Perception evaluations reveal policy-dependent correlations between VLM question-answering and grounding accuracy and VLA manipulation performance. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial instruction following alongside task completion and examining when spatial perception performance translates into robot behavior.
