[229] RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Jie Wang, Bo Zhang, Renzhi Lu, Jianyu Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboDuo，一个以代码为接口的闭环双系统框架，连接编码智能体与两个 VLA：先让全任务 VLA 尝试完整任务并由代码检查是否完成，失败后由原子技能 VLA 完成剩余步骤。该方法无需更新已有全任务 VLA 的权重，并通过构建 LIBERO-Atomic、LIBERO-Code、LIBERO-Judge 训练原子 VLA 和具备完成检查能力的编码智能体。

Details

Motivation: 现有 VLA 直接将指令和观测映射为动作，缺少对任务是否完成的检查，长时序任务中单步失败会被忽略并导致整体失败；而失败轨迹常已部分完成，剩余步骤又是可复用的原子技能，因此可通过原子技能组合进行恢复。

Result: RoboDuo 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 上持续提升 X-VLA 与 π0.5 的表现，长时序任务收益最大，并在真实机器人上恢复了冻结全任务 VLA 的失败 rollout。

Insight: 创新点在于用代码作为编码智能体与 VLA 的接口，实现“尝试—检查—原子恢复”的闭环编排，并复用跨演示出现的原子技能；同时以冻结方式包装现有全任务 VLA，且从同一组 LIBERO 演示构建训练与评测数据集。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map a language instruction and the current observation directly to actions, without checking whether the instruction has been completed. For long-horizon tasks, a single failed step therefore goes unnoticed and leaves the whole task unfinished. Such failed episodes, however, often end with the task partially complete. Moreover, the unfinished steps are reusable atomic skills that recur across demonstrations. A failed attempt can thus be recovered by composing with atomic skills. We propose RoboDuo, a closed-loop dual-system framework that uses code as the interface between a coding agent and two VLAs. The agent writes a program that lets a full-task VLA attempt the whole task and checks whether it is complete; on failure, an atomic VLA finishes the remaining steps. Since the agent emits no actions and only decides which VLA for execution, RoboDuo wraps an existing full-task VLA without updating its weights. To train the atomic VLA and the coding agent with the completion-checking ability, we build LIBERO-Atomic, LIBERO-Code, and LIBERO-Judge from a single set of LIBERO demonstrations. RoboDuo consistently improves X-VLA and $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks, and recovers failed rollouts of a frozen full-task VLA on a real robot.

[230] TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Sooyoung Kwon, Carlee Joe-Wong, Kyunghan Lee

TL;DR: 论文研究VLA模型在嵌入式板卡上的高效推理加速，提出无需训练的TRIAGE方法：通过token级”漂移”诊断，判断每个被跳过的视觉token应复用KV缓存还是剪枝，并固定重算预算以直接控制prefill延迟。TRIAGE优先重算缓存失效的重要token，复用其他有效缓存token，剪枝剩余token，将纯剪枝与纯复用统一为同一分区的两个极端。

Details

Motivation: 移动操作机器人和人形机器人无法连接工作站，必须在板载嵌入式设备上运行VLA模型；而每个控制步需处理数百个视觉token，语言主干的prefill延迟随token数增长，难以满足实时性。现有免训练加速器对每个跳过的token只采用剪枝或复用KV缓存中的一种策略，未考虑两者何时更优。

Result: 在LIBERO和SimplerEnv上，平均成功率与全量重算相差不超过3个百分点；在Jetson AGX Orin上prefill延迟最多降低48%；仅重算7%的视觉token时，在LIBERO-Object上比最强基线高24.4个百分点。诊断实验还显示，漂移超阈值时复用导致的动作误差可达剪枝的4.4倍。

Insight: 创新在于发现”复用还是剪枝”取决于token的漂移（浅层值自缓存计算以来的变化），并据此按backbone校准阈值；将复用与剪枝统一为固定重算预算下的分区策略，预算直接决定prefill延迟，兼顾了自适应性与实时可控性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token’s drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones tested, reusing tokens below a drift threshold was no worse than pruning them, whereas beyond it, reuse yields up to 4.4x the action error of pruning; the same diagnostic calibrates this threshold per backbone. Building on this finding, we propose TRIAGE, which deems a cache valid when its drift is below this threshold and it is not too old. TRIAGE recomputes a fixed budget of tokens, prioritizing important tokens with invalid caches, reuses every other token with a valid cache, and prunes the rest; prune-only and reuse-only methods are the two extremes of this partition. Because the budget fixes the number of recomputed tokens, it directly sets the prefill latency. On LIBERO and SimplerEnv, TRIAGE stays within 3 pp of full recomputation in average success rate while cutting prefill latency on a Jetson AGX Orin by up to 48%, and with only 7% of visual tokens recomputed, it beats the strongest baseline by 24.4 pp on LIBERO-Object.

[231] Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Hyunwoong Bae, Jisu Han, Jiyeon Choi, Dohoon Kim, Taesup Moon

TL;DR: 论文提出 OSMA-Bench，一个基于空间匹配场景集、仅改变障碍物类型来评测家庭机器人导航中障碍物条件安全运动适应的基准，并设计 Semantic Sensitivity Index（SSI）衡量机器人间距、速度与平滑性是否遵循障碍物安全警示顺序。作者评测了基于 VLM 和 VLA 的策略，发现它们即使能识别障碍物安全相关性，也难以将语义安全区分转化为连续运动参数，存在语义到运动的 grounding 缺口。

Details

Motivation: 现有评测未检验机器人是否能根据障碍物类型和距离在连续运动中调节安全间距与速度，同时避免不必要保守；论文旨在评估语义安全区分是否真正反映到运动行为中。

Result: 在 OSMA-Bench 上，VLM 和 VLA 策略即使加入显式安全提示也不能一致地根据障碍物安全等级调整运动；分析显示策略能区分障碍物安全相关性，但运动参数或动作未体现该区分。对先识别障碍再生成导航程序的 VLM 策略，加入显式参数推理步骤可改善适应。

Insight: 创新点在于用空间匹配、仅障碍物类型不同的场景集隔离语义因素，并提出 SSI 量化安全警示顺序与间距/速度/平滑性的一致性；客观看，其价值是揭示并定位“语义到运动 grounding”问题，并给出在语义识别与导航生成之间加入参数推理的改进思路。

Abstract: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the \emph{Semantic Sensitivity Index} (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. Our analysis shows that the policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in the motion parameters or actions they produce. For VLM-based policies, which recognize the obstacle and then generate a navigation program, adding an explicit parameter-inference step between these two stages improves adaptation. These findings expose a gap in \emph{semantic-to-motion grounding}, highlighting the need to translate semantic caution into appropriately safe motion.

[232] SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Luke Hollis, Tianxing Fan, Heng Yang

TL;DR: SceneAgent 是一个将3D/4D视觉捕获自动转换为可交互仿真环境的智能体流水线。它通过基于仿真器的视觉检查与修复来协调物体重建、物理建模和中间错误纠正，支持3DGS、摄影测量、LiDAR、AI生成3DGS及动态4D视频，并集成物体分割、物理参数估计、部件分解、关节与可变形仿真，还能生成物体变体和脚本演示以支持策略学习。

Details

Motivation: 视觉捕获能提供场景外观细节，但转换为可交互仿真环境需重建、物理建模并修正中间误差，现有流程难以自动可靠完成这些多步骤任务。

Result: 在GraspClutter6D杂乱箱体场景中，SceneAgent在1厘米阈值下提升各编码智能体的F1，重建结果优于SimFoundry（最佳F1 60.75% vs 6.9%）；在4DCodeBench三个动态场景上将Gemini 4 Argon平均动态IoU从0.86%提升到99.09%，并展示了初步真机策略迁移。

Insight: 创新点在于用智能体闭环协调多源3D/4D捕获到仿真环境的转换，并以仿真器视觉检查驱动错误修复，统一分割、物理估计、部件/关节/可变形建模，同时生成“数字姐妹”变体和脚本演示支持策略学习。

Abstract: Visual captures provide detailed scene appearance, but converting them into interactive simulation environments requires object reconstruction, physical modeling, and correction of intermediate errors. We present SceneAgent, an agentic pipeline that coordinates these steps through simulator-based visual inspection and repair. The pipeline processes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), photogrammetry, LiDAR captures, AI-generated 3DGS scenes, and 4D videos of dynamic scenes, and combines object segmentation, physical parameter estimation, part decomposition, articulation, and deformable simulation. To support policy learning, SceneAgent generates diverse object variants (“digital sisters”) and scripted demonstrations. On a cluttered bin scene from GraspClutter6D, SceneAgent raises F1 at 1 cm for every coding agent with scorable outputs both with and without its skills, and its reconstructions are better than SimFoundry: all agent configurations exceed SimFoundry’s F1 score, with a best of 60.75% versus 6.9%. On three dynamic scenes from 4DCodeBench, SceneAgent raises the mean dynamic IoU of Gemini 4 Argon from 0.86% to 99.09%. We further demonstrate diverse simulated interactions and preliminary policy transfer to a real robot.

[233] MMGNet: Multi-Modal 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis for Cluttered Scenes cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Rui Cao, Jia-Hui Pan, Yichuan Li, Yunfan Yu, Chi-Wing Fu

TL;DR: 论文提出MMGNet，一种面向杂乱场景的多模态6-DoF抓取合成网络。它通过层次化图像到3D特征注入，将多尺度RGB线索融入点云3D表示形成过程，并利用旋转抓取度建模联合预测抓取接近方向与面内旋转。实验表明两模块互补，在GraspNet-1Billion和真实场景中取得优于对比方法的表现。

Details

Motivation: 场景级6-DoF抓取合成依赖点云获取几何信息，但真实点云常含噪声、不完整且过平滑；RGB图像虽能提供物体区域、边界和外观线索，但在场景表示和局部抓取推理中仍存在两个利用瓶颈。论文旨在有效融合RGB与点云以提升杂乱场景抓取合成。

Result: 在GraspNet-1Billion的RealSense数据上，MMGNet取得60.34的平均AP，超过所有对比方法；在真实对抗抓取物体实验中，抓取成功率比AnyGrasp提升8.46个百分点。消融实验显示两个核心模块带来互补增益。

Insight: 创新点在于层次化图像到3D特征注入，将多尺度图像特征贯穿3D表示形成过程；以及旋转抓取度建模，在通过grasp-shaded grouping组织局部图像特征前联合预测抓取接近方向和面内旋转。客观看，其价值在于针对多模态融合时机与旋转抓取推理瓶颈进行协同设计。

Abstract: Grasping is a foundational capability in robotic manipulation. Scene-level 6-DoF grasp synthesis relies on point clouds for metric geometry, yet real-world point observations are often noisy, incomplete, and over-smoothed. RGB images provide object-region, boundary, and appearance cues, yet two bottlenecks limit their effective use in scene representation and local grasp reasoning. We present MMGNet, a Multi-Modal Grasp Synthesis Network that addresses these bottlenecks through hierarchical image-to-3D feature injection and rotational graspness modeling. Hierarchical injection integrates multi-scale image features throughout 3D representation formation, while the rotational graspness jointly predicts the grasp approach direction and in-plane rotation before organizing local image-informed features through grasp-shaded grouping. Ablation studies show that these two modules provide complementary gains. MMGNet achieves a mean AP of 60.34 on GraspNet-1Billion with RealSense, surpassing all compared methods. In real-world experiments with adversarial grasp objects, MMGNet improves the grasp success rate over AnyGrasp by 8.46 percentage points. \emph{Code, models, and data will be released upon publication.}

[234] Model-Aware Generation of Safety-Critical Scenes for Robust End-to-End Driving via Distilled Planner Surrogates cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Khaled M. Seyam, Julian Wiederer, Samar Fathalah, Markus Braun, Bin Yang

TL;DR: 论文针对端到端驾驶模型在安全关键场景中易碰撞的问题，在NeuroNCAP上分析发现95.9%的DiffusionDrive碰撞源于规划失败而非感知，并将其归因于安全关键交互数据稀缺。作者提出模型感知框架：从特定规划头蒸馏可微代理，在BEV层面生成对抗攻击场景，并用质量-多样性搜索自动配对安全逃逸轨迹；仅渲染少量场景用于微调。在NeuroNCAP上，该方法将SparseDrive和DiffusionDrive闭环碰撞率约减半，同时基本保持正常驾驶。

Details

Motivation: 端到端驾驶模型在标准benchmark表现好但安全关键场景碰撞频繁；分析表明瓶颈在规划而非感知，根因是真实日志中安全关键交互稀少，规划器很少受到此类训练。

Result: 在NeuroNCAP闭环评测中，微调将SparseDrive碰撞率从28.0%降至12.2%，DiffusionDrive从37.5%降至19.2%，约减半且基本保持正常驾驶；跨规划器迁移显示DiffusionDrive用SparseDrive场景微调仅保留18.3个百分点降幅中的6.7，说明收益主要来自针对特定规划器。

Insight: 创新点在于模型感知的安全关键场景生成：用从规划头蒸馏的可微代理在BEV层做攻击，避免昂贵视频渲染器进入攻击循环，并用质量-多样性搜索自动生成攻击与安全逃逸标签，仅渲染少量场景微调。客观看，其价值是把对抗场景生成与规划器特化微调闭环结合，计算效率高且标签自动；但方法强依赖代理保真度且每个规划器需单独生成场景，跨模型泛化有限。

Abstract: End-to-end driving models perform well on standard benchmarks but collide frequently in safety-critical scenarios. We present a failure-mode analysis on NeuroNCAP which shows that 95.9% of DiffusionDrive’s collisions are planning failures despite reliable detection, pinpointing the bottleneck in planning rather than perception. We attribute this to a fundamental data imbalance, as safety-critical interactions are rare in real driving logs, so planners are hardly ever trained on them. We close this gap with a novel model-aware framework that generates safety-critical training scenes against a specific planner. Each planner is attacked at the bird’s-eye-view (BEV) level through a differentiable surrogate distilled from its own planning head. This keeps the expensive video renderer out of the attack loop. We extract 50 scenes per planner, each pairing an attack with a safe escape trajectory that serves as the fine-tuning label. A fully automated quality-diversity search generates both the attacks and the escapes, so that their variety is not specified by hand. Only these scenes are rendered to fine-tune the planner, which reduces the computational cost significantly. Fine-tuning on these scenes roughly halves the closed-loop collision rate of two planners on NeuroNCAP (SparseDrive 28.0% to 12.2%, DiffusionDrive 37.5% to 19.2%) while largely preserving normal driving. A cross-planner transfer experiment shows that the gain comes from targeting the specific planner. Each planner improves most on the scenes generated against itself, and DiffusionDrive fine-tuned on SparseDrive’s scenes retains only 6.7 of its 18.3-point collision-rate reduction.

[235] RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Heyang Yu, Haomin Li, Sihang Li, Jixin Yan, Shiyun Peng

TL;DR: 论文提出RoboDoctor，一个无需训练的执行期自适应框架，将诊断、具身动作和持久经验连接起来，用于机器人策略的递归自我改进。它通过控制分配、选择性干预和操作修正三个目标，在固定模型权重下根据物理反馈调整后续决策，并记录决策原因、尝试方法、结果和复用条件。在54个RoboDojo-Sim任务条目上取得五维平均分57.10和原生成功率49.44%。

Details

Motivation: 通用机器人策略与语言模型智能体能力互补，但完成物理任务需要根据交互后果在执行时自适应；论文关注固定模型权重下如何利用反馈修正后续决策并复用经验。

Result: 在54个RoboDojo-Sim任务条目上，RoboDoctor取得五维平均分57.10、原生成功率49.44%；交互记录展示了策略切换、选择性纠错和抓取修正。摘要未声明SOTA，并强调仍需受控实验验证跨回合经验的贡献。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是无需训练地连接诊断、 grounded action 和持久经验，并在策略与智能体之间分配控制、决定干预时机、通过观测效果修正操作。客观看，核心在于将执行期反馈结构化为可复用经验记录，实现固定权重下的闭环自适应，但跨回合经验的实际增益尚未被受控实验隔离验证。

Abstract: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.

[236] Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Benjamin Pikus, Daniel Saunders, Mircea Mironenco, Salman Mohammadi, Mathew Mathew

TL;DR: 论文提出ZAP，利用预训练27B视觉语言模型提供世界理解与推理，并通过简单工具harness在仿真任务上进行监督微调和GRPO，教会小型现成VLM控制机器人。训练不使用真实机器人数据，却在真实任务上达到96.7%成功率，并展示出对新物体、目标、策略、语言及未见本体的组合泛化能力。

Motivation: 机器人策略需要同时理解任务要求（what）和掌握机器人动作方式（how），而现有方法往往依赖大量真实机器人数据。论文旨在利用预训练模型的知识和仿真环境中的技能学习，实现低成本、可泛化的机器人控制。

Result: 在真实任务上达到96.7%成功率，匹配GPT-6 Astra，显著优于MolmoAct2 VLA的33.3%，且运行快3倍、便宜17倍；在单臂Franka的RoboLab-120上达到55.9%，领先VLA/WAM基线4.9个百分点。

Abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don’t appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

[237] Beyond Visible Speakers: Context-Aware Active Speaker Detection with Speaker Registration cs.SD | cs.CV | cs.MM | eess.AS | eess.IVPDF

Pu Wang, Hugo Van hamme

TL;DR: 论文针对活跃说话人检测（ASD）在拥挤场景或目标人脸不可见时视听对应不可靠的问题，提出ROAM-ASD-C和ROAM-ASD-CR两个扩展模型。前者通过联合推理同时可见的多个候选人，利用其他人脸提供互补证据；后者引入基于注册语音的说话人表示，使系统在说话人未被视觉观测到时仍能判断其是否活跃。

Details

Motivation: 传统ASD依赖语音与可见人脸之间的视听对应，但在拥挤场景、目标遮挡或视觉证据缺失时该假设容易失效。论文旨在提升ASD在复杂和视觉不完整条件下的鲁棒性，并支持不可见说话人的活跃检测。

Result: ROAM-ASD-C在五个ASD基准上达到SOTA：AVA 96.8% mAP、WASD 98.9%、UniTalk 88.8%、Talkies 98.7%、ASW 99.5%；在75%目标轨迹视觉移除条件下，相较ROAM-ASD最高提升13.3 mAP。

Abstract: Active speaker detection (ASD) relies on audiovisual correspondence between speech and visible faces, yet this correspondence becomes unreliable in crowded scenes, or when visual evidence is unavailable. We introduce ROAM-ASD-C and ROAM-ASD-CR to extend ROAM-ASD with contextual and identity-aware reasoning. ROAM-ASD-C jointly reasons across simultaneously visible candidates, allowing other faces to provide complementary evidence when the target observation is ambiguous or incomplete. ROAM-ASD-CR incorporates registered-speaker representations derived from enrollment speech, allowing detection of whether a speaker is active even when that speaker is not visually observed. ROAM-ASD-C achieves state-of-the-art performance across five ASD benchmarks: 96.8% mAP on AVA, 98.9% on WASD, 88.8% on UniTalk, 98.7% on Talkies, and 99.5% on ASW. It also improves ROAM-ASD by up to 13.3 mAP under 75% target-track visual removal.

[238] The Voice on the Line cs.SD | cs.CLPDF

Husein Zolkepli

TL;DR: 论文研究面向实时通话的因果人声隔离：用140M/243M/374M参数的掩码Transformer，在20ms延迟下从通话本身注册呼叫者，并隔离出其声音。作者指出短评估窗口会掩盖长通话中的两类失败（呼叫者长时间不说话后被遗忘、独处时被损伤），并用长通话、跨注意力窗口记忆、真实耳机串扰和电平漂移等设置评估。最终发布模型在AMI等真实/直播设置上优于VoxLock，并蒸馏出22.1M的CPU实时模型开源。

Details

Motivation: 通过单个麦克风转写时会同时拾取附近所有人的声音，因此需要在真实通话中低延迟地只保留已注册呼叫者。现有短窗口评估掩盖了长通话中的记忆、串扰和电平漂移问题，论文旨在解决这些实际部署失败。

Result: 发布模型在60秒AMI窗口上词错误率16.13%，优于VoxLock的23.66%；在其自身AMI窗口上为10.19%对11.71%；在Krisp基准上与VoxLock基本持平（5.74%对5.63%）。但在干净测试通话中独处呼叫者场景不如VoxLock（5.58%对2.92%）。蒸馏的22.1M无WavLM模型可在单CPU线程、20ms帧、每通话约33%核心下实时运行，开发集错误率10.66%（发布模型10.49%）。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新包括：将WavLM-Large权重改为因果并与模型联合训练以改善长通话权衡；用从长通话切出的窗口训练，缓解录音开头独处呼叫者性能下降；以及蒸馏到CPU实时模型并开源LiveKit插件。客观看，核心贡献更在于真实长通话评估设置、预训练语音模型因果化利用和部署级蒸馏，而不仅是隔离器结构本身。

Abstract: A transcriber listening through one microphone also hears everyone near it. We train causal voice isolators: masking transformers of 140M, 243M and 374M parameters, 20 ms of latency, enrolling the caller from the call itself. Short evaluation windows hide two failures that real calls expose: forgetting the caller when another voice talks alone for a while, and damaging a caller who is alone. Long calls with turns, memory beyond the attention window, real headset crosstalk and drifting caller levels address both, but each trades one against the other. WavLM-Large’s own weights, made causal and trained with the model, move the trade: M with them (555M parameters) lowers the error on our development sets from 11.44% to 10.55%; a student trained from scratch to imitate WavLM does not, and w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper’s encoder, pre-trained on far more audio, help less or not at all. A lone caller loses most at the start of a recording: no training call opened with someone already talking. Training on windows cut from longer calls lowers the error on clean development calls from 3.92% to 2.96%; this is our release. Live, the release makes 16.13% word errors on 60 s AMI windows, against 23.66% for VoxLock, the strongest open isolator, and 10.19% on its own AMI windows, against 11.71%; it is level on Krisp’s benchmark (5.74% against 5.63%), and a caller who is alone still loses more words than with VoxLock (5.58% against 2.92% on clean test calls). Distilled into 22.1M parameters without WavLM, it runs live on one CPU thread inside a LiveKit agent, at 33% of a core per call in 20 ms frames, with 10.66% error on our development sets (the release 10.49%). We open-source the release and this CPU model, with a LiveKit plugin, at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator.

[239] WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development cs.SE | cs.CVPDF

Yaorui Ding, Fengqing Jiang, Yichen Feng, Yuetai Li, Zhangchen Xu

TL;DR: 论文提出 WebUniverse，这是一个从开源代码仓库与真实网页中自动构建可验证任务及其已验证开发轨迹（trajectory）的数据流水线，覆盖带文本说明的独立/迭代式应用开发，以及跨页面与视口的视觉复现任务。作者发布了 15K 可执行任务环境 WebUniverse-Env 与 15K 带验证记录与评分的轨迹集 WebUniverse-Mix，并用其对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 进行微调，显著提升智能体在前端 Web 开发任务上的表现。

Details

Motivation: 训练用于前端 Web 开发的智能体需要具备代码编辑、执行、浏览器检查与迭代修改能力的示范数据，但公开的轨迹数据和可复用的任务环境十分稀缺，制约了该方向智能体能力的提升。

Result: 用 WebUniverse-Mix 微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后，Vision2Web 平均分从 51.7 提升至 68.3，WebGen-Bench 准确率从 34.5% 升至 63.9%，Web-Bench pass@2 从 12.2% 升至 23.1%，并在所有指标上优于同等配置与样本预算的公开数据基线；消融显示文本与视觉轨迹互补，且数据从 5K 扩到 15K 仍有持续增益。

Insight: 创新点在于以可验证的方式自动构建任务与轨迹：从真实仓库和网页生成任务，并用任务特定的功能或视觉需求对生成的应用进行验证与评分，从而保证训练数据质量；同时统一了文本驱动开发与视觉复现两类任务，并公开可执行环境与带评分轨迹，兼顾数据规模与可复用性。

Abstract: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages and viewports. We collect agent trajectories for these tasks and verify the resulting applications against task-specific functional or visual requirements. We release WebUniverse-Env, containing 15K executable task environments, and WebUniverse-Mix, containing the corresponding 15K development trajectories with verification records and scores. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix raises the Vision2Web average score from 51.7 to 68.3, WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%, and Web-Bench pass@2 from 12.2% to 23.1%. The resulting model also outperforms a public-data baseline trained with the same configuration and sample budget across all reported metrics. Ablations show complementary benefits from text and visual trajectories and continued gains as training data scales from 5K to 15K trajectories.

[240] A Multimodal Framework for Measuring Creator Communication on Short-Form Video cs.SI | cs.CL | cs.CYPDF

Julie R. Ancis, Michael Fire, Omer Tarshish

TL;DR: 论文提出一个五阶段多模态框架，用于大规模测量短视频创作者的主题与传播策略。框架融合平台元数据、语音转录和采样帧的视觉语言描述，再用大语言模型生成预设指标与开放式标签，并通过审计关键词方案和按创作者加权聚合进行分析。作者在16位创作者的9,852条TikTok视频上演示，最终分析7,311条视频、7类主题和7个传播指标。

Details

Motivation: 短视频同时包含语音、图像和屏幕文字，给系统性内容分析带来挑战；论文希望解决如何在大规模场景下可比较、可验证地测量创作者主题与传播策略的问题。

Result: 在TikTok数据上保留7,311条视频进行分析，自动画像显示创作者在教育、幽默和时事回应等方面存在明显差异。与两位独立专家标注验证时，六个二元指标上框架-专家平均Cohen’s κ为0.40，接近两位专家彼此的κ=0.42，但不同指标间一致性差异较大。

Insight: 创新点在于将平台元数据、语音转录、视觉语言描述和LLM标注整合为模块化多模态分析流程，并引入审计关键词合并、创作者加权聚合和面向构念的验证。客观看，其可借鉴之处是兼顾可扩展自动标注、透明聚合与专家验证，用于短视频传播策略比较分析。

Abstract: Short-form video combines speech, imagery, and on-screen text, creating challenges for systematic content analysis. We present a five-stage multimodal framework for measuring creators’ themes and communication strategies at scale. The framework integrates platform metadata, speech transcripts, and vision-language descriptions of sampled frames, then applies large language models to generate predefined indicators and open-ended labels. An audited keyword scheme consolidates thematic labels, while creator-weighted aggregation gives each account equal weight regardless of posting volume. We demonstrate the framework on 9,852 TikTok videos from sixteen creators, retaining 7,311 videos for analysis across seven themes and seven communication indicators. Automated profiles reveal substantial differences in creators’ use of education, humor, and responses to current events. Validation against two independent expert annotators yielded a mean framework-expert agreement of Cohen’s $κ= 0.40$ across the six binary indicators, close to the $κ= 0.42$ the two experts achieved with each other, though agreement varied substantially across individual indicators. The framework provides a modular approach to comparative analysis of creator communication, combining scalable annotation with transparent aggregation and construct-specific validation.

[241] Investigating the trackability of landmarks in NBI and WLI eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Jonas Below, Piermarco Gerli, Anna Jötten, Dennis Eggert, Axelle Felicio-Briegel

TL;DR: 论文定量比较了喉内镜视频中解剖标志在窄带成像（NBI）与白光成像（WLI）下的视觉可跟踪性。作者使用前向-后向误差框架，在来自39名患者的61段内镜视频上评估声带和具有显著血管模式的黏膜两个感兴趣区域，并比较经典特征跟踪器CSRT与基于学习的点跟踪器CoTracker3-Online、TrackOnR。结果表明NBI总体降低跟踪误差，尤其对声带达到统计显著，且失败率保持较低。

Details

Motivation: 喉部手术计算机辅助干预需要可靠的内镜视频解剖标志跟踪，但NBI虽增强血管对比，其对自动跟踪相对WLI的影响尚不清楚。论文旨在量化NBI与WLI对标志可跟踪性的影响。

Result: 在61段视频、39名患者的数据上，NBI在两个感兴趣区域均一致降低前向-后向误差，其中声带区域达到统计显著，同时失败率保持较低。

Insight: 创新点在于首次系统比较NBI与WLI对喉内镜自动标志跟踪的影响，并跨经典与学习型跟踪器使用前向-后向误差评估。其客观价值是提示成像模态本身可影响跟踪鲁棒性，为运动分析、导航和机器人辅助提供依据。

Abstract: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.

[242] Matching Particle-Arrival Rates for Low-Count Image Denoising eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Huazhen Liu, Zipei Yan, Jizhou Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 PARM，一种面向低计数图像去噪的自监督框架，通过将粒子累积建模为泊松计数过程，并匹配条件粒子到达率进行去噪。方法利用泊松稀疏化把每次观测拆成互补的低曝光视图，使其互为自监督率目标；网络估计归一化空间分配，观测总计数决定全局粒子质量。

Details

Motivation: 低照度或低剂量显微成像中检测到的粒子很少，测量受信号相关泊松散粒噪声主导；监督去噪需要成对干净/噪声数据，而现有自监督方法未直接估计底层粒子到达过程。

Result: 在合成数据、受泊松噪声污染的自然视频序列和真实低剂量电子显微镜数据上，PARM 取得领先或有竞争力的性能，并能有效保留精细结构。

Insight: 创新点在于用泊松计数过程和粒子到达率匹配建立统计基础的自监督去噪，并通过泊松稀疏化构造互补低曝光视图作为监督目标；同时将条件率分解为空间分配与全局粒子质量，兼顾物理建模与网络实现。

Abstract: Low-count imaging arises when limited illumination or dose yields only a few detected particles in microscopy, such as photons or electrons, causing measurements to be dominated by signal-dependent Poisson shot noise. Supervised denoisers typically require paired clean and noisy observations, whereas many self-supervised approaches exploit spatial or temporal redundancy without directly estimating the underlying particle-arrival process. We introduce PARM, a self-supervised denoising framework based on particle-arrival-rate matching. By modeling particle accumulation over exposure as a Poisson counting process, PARM identifies the conditional particle-arrival-rate field with the posterior mean of the latent clean rate. Poisson thinning then splits each observation into complementary lower-exposure views that provide self-supervised rate targets for one another. In implementation, the network estimates the normalized spatial allocation of the conditional rate, while the observed total count determines its global particle mass. Experiments on synthetic data, natural-video sequences corrupted with Poisson noise, and real low-dose electron microscopy demonstrate leading or competitive performance while effectively preserving fine structures. PARM therefore provides a statistically grounded approach to low-count image denoising when clean references are unavailable.

[243] Cross-View and Cross-Time Tracking of Crack Evolution in Concrete eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Pengru Deng, Jiapeng Yao, Su Wang, Xuhui He, Zhao Wang

TL;DR: 论文将混凝土裂缝演化监测定义为跨视角、跨时间的裂缝实例跟踪任务，提出几何辅助、形态感知的框架：先进行图像几何配准将不同视角观测对齐到统一结构参考，再进行形态感知实例化赋予裂缝物理可解释身份，最后在统一视图中进行时间映射以区分新增裂缝与已有裂缝。为评估方法，构建了带时间标注的数据集，覆盖单主裂缝扩展、混合模式分叉和多裂缝交互三类场景。

Details

Motivation: 静态裂缝检测无法提供裂缝扩展的时序信息，而裂缝跟踪需要同时解决视角变化下同一物理裂缝的身份保持，以及统一参考视图中新增生长与已有裂缝段的区分。现有分割和三维重建方法能恢复裂缝掩码或场景几何，但不能跨视角保持裂缝身份或量化时间扩展。

Result: 论文建立了包含像素级掩码和跨时间实例标签的时间标注数据集，覆盖三类代表性开裂场景。实验表明该框架可在视角变化下建立较松的跨视角身份对应，但严格空间重叠和生长定位仍受早期微裂缝可分割性和投影漂移限制，未宣称达到SOTA。

Insight: 主要创新在于将裂缝生长监测形式化为跨视角与跨时间的裂缝实例跟踪任务，并引入几何配准、形态感知实例化和统一视图时间映射的组合框架；同时构建了面向裂缝演化跟踪的时序标注数据集，为后续研究提供评估基础。

Abstract: Crack propagation provides richer information than static crack observations for evaluating structural conditions of concrete infrastructure and planning maintenance strategies. Unlike static crack detection, which can now be largely automated using computer vision, vision-based crack tracking is a coupled cross-view and cross-time problem: the same physical crack must retain its identity as camera viewpoints change, while newly developed growth must be distinguished from existing crack segments in a unified reference view. Existing segmentation and 3D reconstruction methods can recover crack masks or scene geometry, but they do not preserve crack identity across views or quantify temporal extension. To address this gap, this study formulates crack growth monitoring as a cross-view and cross-time crack-instance tracking task and proposes a geometry-assisted, morphology-aware framework. The framework first uses image-based geometric registration to align observations from different viewpoints into a shared structural reference, then applies morphology-aware instantiation to assign physically interpretable crack identities, and finally performs temporal mapping in the unified view to distinguish newly developed growth from existing crack segments. To enable evaluation, a temporally annotated dataset was established and used, covering three representative cracking scenarios: single dominant crack propagation, mixed-mode branching, and multiple-crack interaction, with pixel-level masks and cross-time instance labels. Experimental results show that the proposed framework can establish loose cross-view identity correspondence under changing viewpoints, while strict spatial overlap and growth localization remain limited by early micro-crack segmentability and projection drift, highlighting directions for future crack-monitoring research.

[244] MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Chenglong Ma, Yuanfeng Ji, Junzhi Ning, Jiyao Liu, Yujie Wei

TL;DR: 论文提出 MedVTok，一个通用医学视觉 tokenizer，可将多种成像模态的 2D 图像和 3D 体积映射到统一的 token 空间。它通过切片差分正则化保持跨切片解剖一致性，并用多专家表征对齐融合多个医学专家编码器知识。该 tokenizer 在 2800 万图像和 7 万体积、9 种模态上训练，支持分类、检索、分割、合成、VQA 和报告生成等多种任务。

Details

Motivation: 现有多模态医学 AI 缺乏统一视觉接口，已有医学视觉 tokenizer 往往绑定特定图像维度和成像模态，导致表示碎片化、复用性差。论文旨在构建可统一 2D/3D、多模态和多任务的通用医学视觉 token 接口。

Result: MedVTok 在 28M 图像和 70K 体积、9 种成像模态上训练，并在 24 个基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，覆盖分类、检索、分割、合成、视觉问答和医学报告生成等任务。

Insight: 创新点在于将跨维度医学图像统一到单一 token 空间，并提出切片差分正则化显式建模层间解剖连贯性，以及多专家表征对齐在保留模态特异知识的同时整合多个专家编码器。其可借鉴之处是面向异构医学数据的统一 tokenizer 设计和多专家知识融合策略。

Abstract: Multimodal medical AI requires a common visual interface for encoding heterogeneous imaging evidence for patient condition modeling. However, existing medical visual tokenizers are often tied to a specific dimension and imaging modality, forcing multimodal systems to rely on fragmented and poorly reusable representations. We introduce MedVTok, a general-purpose visual tokenizer that maps 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into a unified token space. Building such a tokenizer poses two key challenges: preserving anatomical structure across dimensions and capturing clinical semantics across modalities. To this end, MedVTok introduces (i) slice differential regularization, which explicitly models inter-slice anatomical coherence missing in previous per-pixel/per-voxel supervision, and (ii) multi-expert representation alignment, which integrates knowledge from multiple medical expert encoders while retaining modality-specific complementary knowledge. Trained on 28M images and 70K volumes across 9 imaging modalities, MedVTok supports classification, retrieval, segmentation, synthesis, visual question answering, and medical report generation through a single tokenizer. Across 24 benchmarks, MedVTok achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating a scalable token interface that unifies medical image dimension, modality, and task usage.

[245] LLMs Can Tackle High Energy Theoretical Physics, yet Gaps Remain: Part I, Quantum Field Theory hep-ph | cs.CLPDF

Tong Liu, Bohan Li, Gongrui Cheng, Zixiong Yu, Yulan He

TL;DR: 论文提出了QFT-Bench基准，包含75个研究生至研究水平的量子场论问题，评估了39个专有和开源大语言模型。结果显示前沿模型在非平凡QFT计算上表现出色，最强模型准确率超过95%，但仍存在计算、约定和指令遵循错误，且模型推理存在不忠实现象。

Details

Motivation: 探究大语言模型在传统上需要理论物理学家大量训练才能解决的高能理论物理问题上的能力边界，特别是量子场论领域缺乏系统评估。

Result: 最强模型在QFT-Bench上准确率超过95%，但即使强模型也在计算、约定和指令遵循上犯错，弱模型则在物理概念和推导上失败；同时发现模型推理存在不忠实性，即答案正确但推理不支撑答案。

Insight: 创新点在于构建了首个量子场论基准测试，结合符号验证和LLM评判进行系统评估；客观分析认为该工作量化了LLM在高级物理推理中的能力与局限，特别揭示了推理不忠实问题，为未来改进提供了方向。

Abstract: Beyond math and code, Large language models (LLMs) are beginning to tackle problems that have traditionally required substantial training for theoretical physicists, but it remains unclear how far this capability extends and where it might break. As a first step toward pushing LLMs in high-energy theoretical physics, we introduce QFT-Bench, a benchmark of 75 graduate- to research-level problems requiring extensive reasoning and derivation across core Quantum Field Theory (QFT) subareas. Each question has a well-defined target and closed-form reference answer. Evaluation combines symbolic verification with LLM-based judge. Across 39 proprietary and open-source models, frontier models already demonstrate substantial capabilities on nontrivial QFT calculations, with the strongest models exceeding 95% accuracy. At the same time, clear gaps remain. Even strong models still make errors in calculations, conventions, and instruction following, while weaker models often fail at the level of physical concepts or derivations. We further monitor models’ CoTs and show that current models exhibit nontrivial reasoning unfaithfulness, i.e., they could reach correct answers but the reasoning itself does not justify and logically support them. These results provide a quantitative assessment of current LLM capabilities in QFT and a first step toward broader evaluation in high-energy theoretical physics.
